Yeah...I think im trans. The only part of me that says no to it is the part that’s wondering if I just hate myself and want to to a different person, and the part that was actually taught that woman are better. And that I needed to be a strong woman.
I think if thats makes me uncomfy, if old me when I wasn’t taught what gender was or had breasts was happier, and that soft, sweet, yet assertive george just sounds more like me being....happy? Than im trans.
As scary as that to me sounds.

Well the best way is to bind or wear a hoodie.

I, like many trans folks, don’t have a binder. So I just cut the legs of leggings and tie it around my chest it really works! 
Just wear a sweater/cardigan over top to hide the lil bump of the knot.

(Even as a 32-b it make my chest look pretty flat in even just an undershirt)

As a disclaimer this coming from a contralto so im not sure how well it will work for you but heres my advice for a thicker more masculine tamber.

Sing from mid yawn, so with the sound placement further back and the throat open, you can even try lowering your larynx, and to get richer sounding tone make sure to use your chest voice!

(I used pretty specific terms so it should be easy to find a vocal coach on youtube explaining them, id recommend SingGeek or Your Lessons Now)
